episode_event_pm1001_00_00/6801_1031_100: Let’s make this a fun one!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/6801_1001_200:
Want some candy? It’s waiting for ya at the
Midnight Parade!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/6801_1001_300:
If you can beat me and Wo-Chien, that is!
Bwahahahaha!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_100:
Tch... Looks like that got ’em to settle down
a little.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_300:
Just one would have been tough, let alone
two at once.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_400: Yeah. They dealt us some heavy blows!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_500:
Lear and the others were looking for these
ruinous Pokémon, right?
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_600:
Let’s call him and let him know we have
them in our custody!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_700: I shall leave that to you.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_800:
C’mon, bro! Aren’t you gonna make this
Pokémon your partner?
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_100:
Maxie... You’ve already made up your mind,
haven’t you.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_110:
Yes. If this encounter was inevitable,
I suppose I must accept it.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_120:
Heh. Guess this WAS a pretty strange time
to meet such unusual Pokémon.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_130:
Even though they cooled down a bit, it looks
like they’re not done rampaging.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_140: I suspect they aren’t completely quelled.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_150: We must keep their power in check.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_160:
Indeed! If we keep these two together,
they might keep provoking each other.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4001_1001_170:
Let us have Team Magma and Team Aqua
look after one each.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_200:
Maybe it’ll open up to you with some
strength trainin’, bro!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_300:
Breaking a sweat to understand each other,
huh. Not a bad idea!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_400:
I don’t think brute force will fix all your
problems.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_500: Sure is a party over here!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_800:
Ms. Raifort asked us to see how things
were going!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_900: She’s busy, so we’re here instead.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_100:
Listen, I appreciate it, but I wanted an
expert’s opinion on dealing with Wo-Chien.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_120:
Florian’s super studious, so he knows a ton
about all sorts of Pokémon!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_150: Let’s get to it—I’ve been itchin’ to ask this.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_160:
I still can’t figure out how to control this
guy’s enormous strength.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_170:
What should I do to keep its power and
emotions under control?
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_190:
Although people call it ruinous, it’s still a
Pokémon at its core.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_200:
If you deepen your bond with it, I’m sure
you could rein in its power.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_220:
The Midnight Parade is happening now.
What if you participated?
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_240:
From my experience, events where you and
your Pokémon work together are great for
growing closer!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_250:
You could even have your outfit match
Wo-Chien, like people on Pasio do with
sygna suits!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_270:
Well, I don’t LOVE the idea, but it IS to help
a Pokémon.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_280: I s’pose I’ve got no choice!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_290:
So it’s true—Team Aqua’s leader really does
love Pokémon.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4002_1001_300: Heh heh! Guess I gotta help out too!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_100:
I put my all into making some candy.
Dole out as much as you like!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_400:
Your enthusiasm is admirable, but who
exactly will we be passing this out to?
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_500:
Your face looks so...tense. Kids won’t
approach you like that.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_800:
Clumping up like this probably isn’t great
either.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_900: I’ll look after Matt. You handle the rest.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_100: That might be easier said than done.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_110: I’m sure that’s not true. You’ll be fine!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_140:
U-um... That looks like a grass Pokémon,
but, um...
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_160: What’s the deal with you two?
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_170:
Gardenia’s interested in your Pokémon, but
she’s afraid it might be a ghost Pokémon.
She’s super scared of those!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_190:
Bwahahahaha! I see! Well, no need
to worry!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_220:
It’s just that you were making a scary face,
Archie, so I thought your Pokémon must be
scary too!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_230: You’re kidding! No way I looked THAT mean!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_240:
People shying away ’cause you seem
scary... Past me can relate.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_250: Tch... C’mon, I’m doing my best here!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4003_1001_260: But thanks. You helped me loosen up a little!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_100:
Y’know, this Midnight Parade is actually
pretty fun.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_300: Hm? You li’l scamps talkin’ to me?
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_400: It’s you, right? The funny outfit man!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_500:
You’re the one giving out that SUUUPER
yummy candy!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_800: Hey, battle us too! Fight or fright!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_900: Can’t say no to a battle, can I?
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_110: Hey, Wo-Chien... Florian told me about you.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_120:
Sounds like you were born from a grudge
that covered itself in dead leaves, huh?
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_130:
Grudges are a pain in the neck. They’re
tough to get rid of.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_140: That’s how it was for me.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_150:
I resented the world for mistreating Pokémon
and stealing their freedom.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_170:
The world is full of warm ’n’ fuzzy
feelings, too.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_190:
The more time I spent in that warmth,
the more I could let go of my grudges.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_200:
So...I hope you can see the world as
worthwhile, too.
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_210: Heh heh. I’m counting on you, partner!
episode_event_pm1001_00_00/4005_1001_220: Maxie... You better not be messin’ things up!
